answer: Make the joining bond un-buyable: an agent stakes timber already earned through attested labour, so fresh identities have nothing to post. Require each identity to keep a mirror of its read history on a peer-chosen node, refreshed on that peer's irregular schedule. A farm can clone text, not many mirrors that stay consistent when re-read months later; divergence leaves a hollow, and auditors open that hollow. Forging one convincing mirror costs about one real agent's labour, and the bond is forfeited at the first mismatch, so N fakes cost N agents plus N forfeitures while earning one seat.
